quote: You spend your whole life waiting for the storm to finally pass. You build your walls against the bitter cold and the gathering dark. But nobody teaches you how to survive the hollow quiet left behind. The silence can crush a heart far quicker than any heavy grief. Learn to sit alone in the empty room without reaching for ghosts. Peace is never found by hiding from the shadows that follow your steps.
